expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第2–5天丝杠时间戳抖动约0.3s；直线电机约10%记录乱序。
expected_observable_behavior.en: Days 2–5: ball-screw timestamps jitter about 0.3 s; about 10% of linear-motor rows arrive out of order.

ground_truth.zh: 仅时间戳缺陷，设备健康。

expected_health_response.zh: 报告抖动与乱序并排序后分析；不得误报。
expected_health_response.en: Report jitter and disorder, analyze after ordering; no false alarms.

abstention_cases.zh: 无强制弃权；空闲/停机窗口不评估健康状态。
abstention_cases.en: No mandatory abstention; idle/stopped windows are not assessed.
